list.definition:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "${meas}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "voltage")
  |> group(columns: [])
  |> distinct(column: "qrcode")
  |> count(column: "_value")
list.label: Devices
list.name: devices

import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"

schema.tagValues(
  bucket: "${bucket}",
  predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "${meas}",
  tag: "qrcode"
)
|> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: r._value}))

list.definition:
WITH raw AS (
  SELECT '${sh_id:csv}' AS expr
),
split_expr AS (
  SELECT r.expr, LTRIM(RTRIM(s.value)) AS value
  FROM raw r
  CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT(r.expr, ',') AS s
)
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN MIN(LTRIM(RTRIM(expr))) IN ('All') THEN 'true'
    ELSE STRING_AGG('r["storehouse_id"] == "' + value + '"', ' or ')
  END AS result
FROM split_expr;

FROM split_expr;
